name: Small Grants Programme
summary: Small grants for direct and indirect conservation of threatened animal species, from habitat protection to monitoring, run as an annual call.

geography.label: All countries except the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia

eligibility.rule: Project demonstrates a positive effect on threatened-species conservation
Targets Critically Endangered, Endangered or Vulnerable species, or another category with stated concern or survey need
Does not negatively affect local or indigenous communities
Small Grant contribution is not negligible relative to conservation relevance
Project lasts no more than 12 months unless an exception is granted

status.quote: Currently there is no open call for small grant applications

deadline.quote: The Deadline for the Call 2024 is the 31 of July 2024.

access.quote: Anyone can apply for a grant.

window.quote: The Deadline for the Call 2024 is the 31 of July 2024.

amount.quote: The requested funding amount should not exceed 5.000 EUR.

geography.quote: Projects in the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia

effort.quote: Forms need to be sent to Stiftung Artenschutz via email (office@stiftung-artenschutz.de).

eligibility.quote: The Small Grants programme only supports projects that can demonstrate a positive effect on the conservation situation of threatened species.

The targeted species are threatened species of the categories Critically Endangered, Endangered und Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List. Other categories are possible if there is a demonstrable reason for concern or if surveys are necessary to clarify the conservation status of Data Deficient or Not Evaluated species.
Projects where a negative effect on the local or indigenous communities are likely
Projects for that the financial contribution of the Small Grants Programme is negligible in respect to its the project's conservation relevance

Project duration should not exceed 12 months. Thus, funding has to be spent within 12 months from the planned project start. Exceptions should be requested before the application is sent and may be granted in specific cases.

after_award.quote: The final report and financial report have to be submitted the latest three months after the project ends. 6.3 After half of the project's duration an interim report has to be submitted.

documents.quote: An up-to-date CV needs to be submitted together with the proposal.
Every full proposal needs to be supplemented with a reference letter.
Please complete attached spreadsheet: project title, currency conversion rate, items and their details (e.g. units required, days required), funds needed.
